content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is there a way to delete the program stored on a memory card? I have not seen this option available in [product_name] or in the related software. The manuals and FAQs also do not provide any useful guidance. Thank you for your help. [user_name]
Hi [user_name], To remove the existing program from the card, simply overwrite it by copying a new program. If you want the card to be empty, just copy a blank program to it.

analysis.insight_summary: The user notes there is no clear option to erase a memory card via the [product_name] device or its associated software, and that documentation is not helpful. The reply clarifies that erasing is done indirectly, by copying an empty program to the card, indicating usability drawbacks regarding basic file management tasks.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an obvious and straightforward method to erase a memory card, available within the device, software, or official documentation.
